newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Recor Holdings mulls sales of control.
newsitem.headline: Recor Holdings mulls sales of control.

text.p: Audio products and televisions maker Recor Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had been approached by a potential investor on injecting equity into the company to strengthen its current financial position.
"The deal, if made, may or may not lead to a change in control of the company," chairman James Hon said in a statement.
"The matter is still in the preliminary stage and no understanding, arrangement or agreement of any kind has been reached," he said.
The company said the potential investors was a financially strong China based group.

Recor also said it had obtained approval from Chinese authorities to postpone the development of industrial land in China's Dongguan and it was considering different alternatives for the use of the land including sale of the land.
Recor also said it was considering sale of its loss-making electronic products manufacturer Recor (Fuzhou) Electronic Ltd to streamline operations and to reduce operating costs.

The company said the sale of the unit would not have any material impact on the company's profitability as the unit did not make up the core-business of Recor. Trading in Recor shares remains suspended pending further announcements.
